events.summary: Regna tells Krav that a beast never stood a chance against them.
events.quote: "Big, wicked, and not too smart. Poor thing never stood a chance against us, dear."

events.summary: Krav calls on his love to show them the light.
events.quote: "Show them the light, my love."

events.summary: Will asks if the plan will work and Rowan says it will be spectacular if it does.
events.quote: "No," said Rowan. "But if it does, it's going to be spectacular."

events.summary: Zndrsplt retired from officiating when she teamed up with Okaun.
events.quote: Zndrsplt retired from officiating when she teamed up with Okaun

events.summary: Virtus greets Gorm and they dismiss someone as no one at all.
events.quote: "No one, Virtus. No one at all."

events.summary: Mangara of Corondor says he has been brought to a place he cannot leave and, though free of the amber, remains in prison.
events.quote: "I have been brought to this place and I cannot leave.

events.summary: Gideon Jura vows that though Sea Gate has fallen they still stand and fight.
events.quote: "Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand.

events.summary: Jace Beleren remarks on the people of this plane replicating magical techniques.
events.quote: "It is fascinating to see how the people of this plane replicate magical techniques without a natural gift.

events.summary: Zul Ashur tells a listener it would be a shame to let them die of old age.
events.quote: "You harbor such vast potential.

events.summary: Senifet offers to write down a lesson for someone.
events.quote: "You wish to remember this lesson? I will write it down for you."

events.summary: Lord Gonti met with Consul Kambal on the day the Prakhata Club closed.
events.quote: It's also rare that Lord Gonti meets with Consul Kambal.

events.summary: Raising the bones of Hekjek the Mad proved easier than getting them to lie back down.
events.quote: Raising the bones of Hekjek the Mad proved far easier than getting them to lie back down.

events.summary: Xenagos muses that the gods of Theros are born of mortals' beliefs and what that says of his own godhood.
events.quote: "The gods of Theros are born of the expectations and beliefs of mortals.

events.summary: Zurgo tells Sarkhan he made a legend from what Sarkhan abandoned.
events.quote: I made a legend from what you abandoned."

events.summary: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm with Zendikari allies charging behind them.
events.quote: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.

events.summary: Teferi muses to Jhoira about nature mages venerating the work of Urza's apprentice.
events.quote: "What would Urza think, I wonder, if he could hear how the nature mages still snarl at his name, but venerate the work of his apprentice?"

events.summary: Najiya warns Gideon that the plated crusher is not interested in his concept of strength through unity.
events.quote: It's not interested in your concept of strength through unity.

events.summary: Sheoldred teaches that pain is a sign of imperfection.
events.quote: "Pain isn't a negative stimulus. Pain is a sign of your imperfection."

events.summary: Memnarch notes the myr population grows with his experimental population.
events.quote: As the experimental population grows, so does the number of myr.

events.summary: Selesnya missionaries moved into the Shanav Quarter and faced scorn, ridicule, and martyrdom.
events.quote: When Selesnya missionaries moved into the Shanav Quarter, they faced scorn, ridicule, and ultimately martyrdom.
